The '''stillsail''' was a type of membranous creature that lived in the [[Stratos Distribution/Legends|Stratos Distribution]], a vast [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] corridor of dust, [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] made up of [[Water/Legends|ice]] and [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]]-rich rock, and [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] [[Comet/Legends|comet]] fronds. The stillsails measured more than a hundred thousand [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] across, and they shared their habitat with [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] [[lightning-jack]]s and asteroid-burrowing [[Worm/Legends|wormlike]] [[chewer]]s, the latter of which were evolutionarily related to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Lugubraa]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that also originated in the Stratos Distribution.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stillsails were introduced in ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', a sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2010]].<ref name="TUR" />
